title: PR #1103 Review: Language Alignment (Notebook, Feed, Note, Page)
subtitle: Architectural evaluation, spec compliance audit, missed items, and post-cutover code simplification catalog for feat/language-alignment-integrated vs main

components.title: Strong architectural unification across 12 tickets, with one user-facing WQL guide bug and ~300 lines of post-cutover dead weight ready to trim
components.body: PR #1103 executes a repo-wide domain cutover across packages/core, packages/wql, packages/storage, packages/engine, packages/tools, packages/ui, and apps/playground. It collapses four competing container terms (notebook, collection, catalog, dated feed) into Notebook, re-anchors Feed as the configured publishing source, makes Page a true many-to-many placement layer, and unifies L1/L2/L3 navigation with WQL list surfaces. The core architecture, storage invariants, and read-side migrations are solid. Before or immediately after merge, fix the stale source:feeds examples in the WQL guide (which fail the parser) and trim the orphaned functions, duplicate fields, and transitional adapters left behind.

components.title: 1. What was done well and architectural improvements
components.body: This PR does not stop at string renames. It replaces scattered per-surface heuristics with single-owner resolvers and shared tables across storage, WQL, and the UI.

components.title: Nine structural improvements delivered by PR #1103

items.title: One container decision shared by JS and SQL
items.body: packages/wql/src/QueryService.ts:149-291 defines notebookOfItem, notebookOriginOfItem, and SOURCE_ID_SHAPES. packages/storage/src/sql/domain.ts:683-695 generates sourceKindSql from the same sourceShape accessor, so the SQL projection and JS residual filter cannot drift.

items.title: Editability follows notebook ownership, not per-note stamps
items.body: packages/core/src/types/notebook.ts:32-46 (isNoteEditable) and QueryService.ts:213-220 (notebookOriginOfItem) derive editability from the notebook. Cloning a feed note into a user notebook makes it editable by location while preserving its seed/feed provenance.

items.title: Pages are genuine many-to-many placements with atomic moves
items.body: packages/core/src/models/PagePlacement.ts:54-89 defines canonical position-first ordering. StorageService.ts:403-484 implements addNoteToPage (append position, no detach), removeNoteFromPage, and transactional moveNoteBetweenPages, verified by fault-injection rollback tests.

items.title: Efforts and equipment import as notes + registry projections in one tx
items.body: packages/tools/src/cli/persist.ts and packages/engine/src/seed/runtime.ts write the definition Note and its typed IEffort/IEquipment projection atomically. WQL :effort queries filter via the registry and resolve to owning definition notes via ownerNoteId.

items.title: First-class :notebook, :page, :tag, and :equipment planes
items.body: packages/wql/src/vocabulary.ts:111,188 and QueryService.ts:2495-2690 add the four planes, add the contributes: filter on :tag{}, push typed-tag predicates down to SQL on the note plane, and delete the unimplemented has: and retired catalog: keys.

items.title: Sidebar L1 zones derive directly from canonical list routes
items.body: apps/playground/app/nav/appNavTree.ts:118-148 derives L1 id and label from the route path (/notebooks -> Notebooks). Journal and Playgrounds fold into NotebookZonePanel.tsx while keeping route-keyed query settings and L3 document outlines.

items.title: Every library list route is a WQL stream surface
items.body: apps/playground/app/views/stream/streamProfile.ts:109-281 binds every list route (/notebooks, /notes, /feeds, /pages, /efforts, /equipment, /tags, /journal, /sessions, /playgrounds) to QueriableStreamView. /tags replaces its bespoke chip list with :tag{} rows linking to /t/:type/:tag.

items.title: Idempotent storage, checkpoint, and settings migrations
items.body: packages/wql/src/notebookVocabulary.ts:18-102 rewrites legacy collection.*/feed.* chunk IDs, sourcePaths, and sourceIds in one boot transaction (runtime.ts:517-549). viewSettingsStorage.ts and routeWqlConfig.ts migrate saved settings across two-hop route renames while isolating new /feeds settings.

items.title: Effort stream re-queries when the effort registry hydrates
items.body: apps/playground/src/services/effortRegistry.ts:18-24 and QueriableStreamView.tsx subscribe the effort plane to registry hydration notifications, eliminating the race where :effort ran once against an empty registry during cold boot.

components.title: Before vs. after concept alignment across the four surfaces
components.body: Every domain concept now has one noun, one direct route prefix, one plural list route, and a WQL head.

components.title: 2. What was missed: bugs, stale docs, and spec divergences
components.body: Comparing the implementation against docs/language-alignment.html and scanning the worktree for retired vocabulary surfaced one user-visible documentation bug, several stale glossary/comment references, and a set of deliberate or partial spec divergences.

components.title: Pre-merge fix required: seeded WQL guide and CONTEXT.md teach unparseable source:feeds
components.body: packages/wql/src/wql.ts:579-581 explicitly rejects source:feed, source:feeds, and source:feed:* with a parse error ('source:feeds is retired — the feed corpus is the notebook plane; use source:notebooks or notebook:<slug>'). However, markdown/canvas/guide/wql.md:118 and :164 still instruct users to write source:feeds, and CONTEXT.md:594,598 repeats source:feeds and feed:<slug>. Because markdown/canvas/guide/wql.md is compiled into the core seed and rendered at /page/guide-wql, the live app currently teaches syntax that the WQL parser rejects.

components.title: 3. Standards, code smells, and edge-case risks
components.body: Inspection of the 476-file diff against repo conventions (AGENTS.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md) and Qodana's PR report.

components.title: Standards violations, Qodana warnings, and runtime edge cases
rows: Mid-file import & re-export of DEFAULT_NOTEBOOK_SLUGS, isNoteEditable, etc. placed after function notebookSlugOfSourceId (line 91)
Move import and re-export block to top of file with the other @bitcobblers/wod-wiki-core imports (lines 22-23)
Mixes deep relative imports (../../types/..., ../types/notebook) with @/* path aliases in the same file (Qodana 'Import can be shortened')
Use @/* path alias consistently for src/ imports per .github/copilot-instructions.md

landingRawContent interpolates user notebook description and icon into YAML frontmatter without quoting (`description: ${meta.description}`); colons or hashes in descriptions corrupt generic frontmatter parsers
JSON.stringify or YAML-quote scalar values when serializing landing note frontmatter
handleDelete uses try { ... } finally { ... } without a catch block; a rejected delete leaves an unhandled promise rejection with no user feedback
Add catch block to surface or log deletion errors cleanly

Walk the full LEGACY_ROUTE_ALIASES chain on reset just as readRaw does on load

Add and Move reject supplying both date and slug, but Clone passes both journalDate and slug simultaneously; line 209 also throws an Error caught immediately at line 213 for local control flow (Qodana warning)

components.title: 4. Dead code & simplification opportunities unlocked by PR #1103
components.body: Because PR #1103 collapsed collections, feeds, and templates into notebooks and notes, several helper functions, legacy layout templates, dual provenance fields, and parallel adapter layers are now unused or redundant.

components.body: Every item below was verified via repo-wide grep across packages/, apps/, e2e/, and scripts/.

0 callers anywhere. Date-key summarization moved to notebookGalleryModel.summarizeGrouping (notebookGalleryModel.ts:88-97).
Docstring says 'Legacy signature kept for existing callers and tests', but 0 callers or tests reference either symbol.

items.title: Drop Entry.noteId (always identical to Entry.id)
items.body: In apps/playground/app/lib/entryMapper.ts:224,229, toEntry sets both id: note.id and noteId: note.id, while effortToEntry, rowsRunToEntry, and unifiedEventToEntry never set noteId. All 10 consumer sites doing `entry.noteId ?? entry.id` (entrySearch.ts:148, FacetProperties.tsx:235,515, conditionsFacets.ts:483-515, LibraryRow.tsx:251, StreamFeed.tsx:202, QueriableStreamView.tsx:1207) can use `entry.id` directly.

items.title: Collapse Notebook.id + 5 write-only fields on Notebook
items.body: Every Notebook constructor in NotebookService.ts sets `id` and `notebookId` to the exact same `notebook/{slug}` value. Moreover, `feedEntryId`, `packageId`, `sourceUrl`, `repositoryUrl`, and `lastEditedAt` on the Notebook interface (packages/core/src/types/notebook.ts:60-70) are populated by NotebookService.ts:74-80,135-183 and never read anywhere in apps/. `getFeedNotebooks(options?: { onlySubscribed })` also has 0 callers passing options.

items.title: Note.feedOrigin is 100% derivable from Note.feedSourceId
items.body: packages/storage/src/validation.ts:42-44 enforces `feedOrigin === 'feed' <=> Boolean(feedSourceId)`. Only two places read `feedOrigin` (`isNoteEditable` in notebook.ts:45 and `isJournalRow` in QueryService.ts:247), both of which can check `!note.feedSourceId`. Removing `feedOrigin` (or deriving it at read time) eliminates `FeedOrigin` across core, engine, storage, and WQL.

items.title: Unify the 3 copies of the core/default notebooks table
items.body: The built-in notebooks (journal, playground, defaults, guides, efforts, equipment, dashboards) are defined three times: DEFAULT_NOTEBOOK_SLUGS in packages/core/src/types/notebook.ts:11, RESERVED_SLUGS + getDefaultNotebooks() in NotebookService.ts:32-40,92-186, and CORE_NOTEBOOKS in notebookGalleryModel.ts:163-170. A single declarative metadata table in core or feedSources removes ~45 lines and prevents drift.

items.title: Merge script-notebooks.ts into groupings.ts
items.body: Before PR #1103, groupings.ts was shared by two adapters (script-collections.ts and script-feeds.ts). Now script-notebooks.ts is the sole consumer and copies every Grouping/GroupingItem field 1:1 just to sort items (script-notebooks.ts:51-77), while groupings.ts:55,132 keeps a vestigial `root: GroupingRoot = 'notebooks'` parameter. Moving the item sort into groupings.ts lets ScriptNotebook alias Grouping directly (~35 lines saved).

items.title: Deduplicate WQL_SOURCES, notebook tag helpers, and gallery helpers
items.body: 1) packages/wql/src/vocabulary.ts:200 defines WQL_SOURCES identically to WQL_FIND_TARGETS (:111) — alias it. 2) apps/playground/src/types/notebook.ts:43-56 re-implements NOTEBOOK_TAG_PREFIX and toNotebookTag instead of re-exporting from @bitcobblers/wod-wiki-core. 3) notebookGalleryModel.ts exports filterNotebooks, sortNotebooks, and groupNotebooksByFeed which are only used in unit tests (production uses the Feed-level equivalents).
